findings.message: No DTM: the DTM folder has no elevation raster. The analysis cannot run.
findings.action: Copy ONE bare-earth elevation raster (for example the HRDEM 'dtm' GeoTIFF) into 01_Elevation\DTM.

findings.message: No DSM: trees, buildings and towers will NOT be detected and every rating is capped at Marginal.
findings.action: Copy the surface model that matches the DTM (for example HRDEM 'dsm') into 01_Elevation\DSM.

findings.message: No water polygons: lakes, ponds and rivers are NOT excluded and can be rated as excellent landing zones.
findings.action: Copy a water polygon layer (Ontario Hydro Network - Waterbody, NRCan NHN, USGS NHD, OpenStreetMap water) into 02_Hydrology.

findings.message: No other exclusion areas (optional: wetlands, built-up or restricted areas).
No AOI: the analysis uses the current map view, or the whole DTM.
findings.action: Optional: put one area-of-interest polygon in 04_AOI.

findings.message: 288 GB free on the disk (estimate for a full run of this DTM: up to 5 GB).
